info.title: Kling 4.0 Omni Reference Video Task - Submit Task
info.description: Submit a Kling 4.0 omni reference video task via `/kling/omni-video`, supporting images, videos, elements, and voices as references, as well as video editing. Query task status with `GET /kling/tasks`.

post.description: Submit a Kling 4.0 omni reference video task via `/kling/omni-video`; the model is specified by `model_name`. Supports images, videos, elements, and voices as reference materials, and accepts a base video for video editing. Query task status with `GET /kling/tasks`.

contents.text: Follow the camera movement and pacing of @video_1, replace the subject with the car in @image_1, and the background with @image_2.
Edit @video_1 to remove the person in the foreground; keep everything else unchanged.

bearerAuth.description: Pass `Authorization: Bearer <token>` in the request header.

type.description: Material type: prompt (`prompt`), keyframe image (`first_frame` / `middle_frame` / `last_frame`), reference image (`refer_image`), feature reference video (`feature_video`), base video to edit (`base_video`), element (`element`), or voice (`voice`).

text.description:
Prompt text, required when `type=prompt`.
- Up to 26,000 characters for pure English, 11,000 for pure non-English
- Mixed input must satisfy: English characters/26000 + non-English characters/11000 ≤ 1
- Organize the prompt as material usage, overall setup, scene-by-scene events, and audio requirements, and reference materials with `@id`

url.description:
Image or video URL, required for image and video materials.

Images (`first_frame` / `middle_frame` / `last_frame` / `refer_image`):
- Accepts URL or Base64, formats .jpg / .jpeg / .png, up to 30 MB each
- At least 300 px in width and height, aspect ratio 2:5–5:2

Videos (`feature_video` / `base_video`):
- URL only, formats .mp4 / .mov, up to 300 MB
- Each video and the total video duration must be between 3 and 30 seconds
- Dimensions between 700 and 4553 px, total pixels at most 8294400, aspect ratio 2:5–5:2
- Supports 24–60 fps input; output frame rate is 24 fps

element_id.description: Element ID generated by the system, required when `type=element`. Elements are either video character elements or multi-image elements, with different applicable scopes.

voice_id.description: Voice ID generated by the system, required when `type=voice`. Up to 3 voices are supported.

id.description: Material index ID used to reference the material in the prompt via `@<id>`. Must be unique within the same task. Required when there are multiple middle frames or reference images.

audio.description:
How the generated video handles audio.
- `native`: generate audio matching the visuals
- `original`: keep the original audio of the input video. Cannot be combined with voice references; at least one `base_video` or `feature_video` is required

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio (width:height) of the generated video. Any valid ratio other than `adaptive` takes precedence over the prompt; with `adaptive`, the ratio recognized from the prompt is used first, then the base video, keyframe images, and feature video in order, defaulting to 16:9 when none applies.

duration.description:
Target video duration in seconds; supports integers from 3 to 30.
- When set, this value takes precedence over any duration in the prompt
- When omitted, the explicit duration recognized from the prompt is used
- When omitted and no explicit duration is found in the prompt, uses the rounded duration of `base_video` if provided, otherwise 10 seconds

The final target duration is used for billing and is available as `usage.output_duration` in the task query response.

callback_url.description: Callback URL for task results. When configured, the server notifies you whenever the task status changes.

external_task_id.description:
Custom task ID.
- It does not override the system-generated task ID, but can be used to query the task
- Must be unique per user

watermark_info.description: Whether to also generate a watermarked result. Configured with `enabled`; custom watermarks are not supported.

enabled.description: `true` generates a watermarked result, `false` does not.

contents.description:
Materials for generation, such as prompts, images, videos, elements, and voices. Must include a `type=prompt` item.
- Up to 10 images
- Images + videos + elements + voices must not exceed 15 in total
- Up to 7 elements, of which at most 3 video character elements
- Up to 5 reference videos; with video character elements, the total of elements and reference videos must not exceed 5; at most 1 `base_video`
- Up to 3 voices
- When `first_frame`, `last_frame`, and `refer_image` coexist, keep `first_frame` first and `last_frame` last

code.description: Error code; see the error code documentation.

request_id.description: Request ID generated by the system for tracking and troubleshooting.

status.description: Task status: submitted, processing, succeeded, or failed.

create_time.description: Task creation time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

update_time.description: Task update time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

external_id.description: Custom task ID of this task, if any.
